subject: Next steps: PO binding criteria, invoice routing, and VAT fallback for TierOne

Cc: TierOne Logistics AP <ap@tierone.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference (PO workflow & VAT)

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. We're getting Redwood set up in our AP system and I need a short checklist of items TierOne requires to process invoices and tie them to POs. Two specifics we run into frequently:

- Legal name / tax ID match for supplier record (W9/W8-BEN equivalent)
- Preferred invoice deliverable (PDF via email vs e-invoice/EDI) and the required PO field to link (we use "Buyer PO Number" and sometimes need a "Contract Line Item")

Can you confirm what Redwood needs to provide today so we can avoid payment delays? Also, do you have a bank remit PDF we can keep on file and a sample invoice showing the PO mapping?

Thanks — appreciate a one-page checklist if possible.

Sally Price
Senior AP Manager
TierOne Logistics

Attachment: none (initial request)

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference (PO workflow & VAT)

Hi Sally —

Thank you — this is great. Quick answers and what we'll attach: 

1) Legal & tax evidence: we'll send a completed W-9 (redwood_W9.pdf). For EU VAT scenarios we can provide a VAT-registration extract on request.

2) Invoice delivery: we can accept PDF invoices via email (AP inbox) and also support e-invoice via PEPPOL if you prefer. For immediate processing, please route invoice PDFs to ap@tierone.com and include the exact PO number in the "Buyer PO Number" field on the invoice body and filename. Our sample invoice shows how we place PO + Tax/VAT lines. (sample_invoice_redwood.xlsx attached)

3) Remittance/bank details: attached redwood_bank_details.pdf. Note: we prefer ACH / bank transfer for US payments; if wire is required we include the SWIFT in the bank PDF.

4) PO binding: our invoices will reference the PO numeric code. If TierOne requires a line-item match, include the PO plus line item in the invoice; otherwise we will apply to the top-level PO. We can tag invoices with your Contract Line Item identifier in a custom field if you provide the label.

Next steps from our side: attaching W9, bank PDF, and a labeled sample invoice. Marissa, looping you for any rate/contract phrasing that needs to be copied into the vendor record. Karthik, can you confirm whether we need to supply a US tax treaty or additional export documentation?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_W9.pdf (pdf), redwood_bank_details.pdf (pdf), sample_invoice_redwood.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Sally / Rishi —

Quick commercial note to reduce friction: TierOne can expect Redwood invoices to contain all required elements for PO matching: legal entity name, invoice number, invoice date, total excluding tax, tax/VAT line separated, gross total, and the explicit Buyer PO Number field. Standard payment terms for the account are Net 30 from invoice date unless a different term is specified on the PO.

If TierOne requires a PDF header to include "Supplier ID" or "Vendor Code" (your internal vendor number), we can add that to the invoice filename and in the top-left header for rapid matching. Also confirm whether TierOne's AP requires supplier classification fields (goods vs services) — happy to add that column.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
